# NiroLearn

> NiroLearn (nirolearn.com) is an Arabic-first AI study platform for students. A student uploads their own study material as a PDF (a textbook, lecture file or past-exam question file) and NiroLearn turns it into study tools built from that file.

The interface is in Arabic. Students can upload material in Arabic or English (for example medicine and engineering). For English material, explanations keep the original English terminology and add an Arabic support explanation plus a bilingual list of key terms. Text is read even from scanned pages.

## What it does

- Organized summary (تلخيص PDF) for each part of the file, with headings and key points.
- Exam Focus: the high-importance, exam-relevant facts pulled from the whole file, grouped by type (must-know, numbers and limits, exam traps, comparisons…), each with the page it came from.
- Flashcards (فلاش كارد) generated from the file, scheduled with spaced repetition based on how the student rates each card.
- Multiple-choice quizzes built from the file, with an explanation for each answer.
- Mind map (خريطة ذهنية) for each part of the file.
- Niro, a study assistant that answers questions using the file's own pages.
- PDF reader with highlights and notes; past-exam question files turned into review cards; study packs shared with classmates.
- A Telegram bot (@Nirolearnbot): a student sends a PDF in Telegram and opens the result — interactive questions with an Arabic explanation per answer, or the book in their library — inside Telegram or the browser.

## Studying together (free)

- Study rooms (غرف مذاكرة): free online group study rooms of 2 to 20 members, private by link or public in a subject section, optionally for female students only. Voice with raised hands; the leader shows a PDF to everyone with the pages one under the other, and members write on it together with a pen, a highlighter, an eraser and a lasso; a chat whose messages carry their page or video moment.
- Watch YouTube together: the leader pastes a YouTube link and the video plays, pauses and seeks in sync for everyone in the room while they talk.
- Group quizzes: the room plays a quiz together — the same question for everyone at the same moment, points for right and fast answers, and a podium at the end. From the student's own question file or from Discover.
- Discover (استكشف): a catalogue of ready general-knowledge quizzes in Arabic and English, in subject sections and channels, played alone (learn mode or swipe cards) or with friends in a room. Every quiz also has a public page that works without signing up.

## Who it is for

University and school students across the Arab world who study from large PDF books, lecture files and past exam papers.

## Plans

Free plan with all study tools at lower usage limits (no payment card needed). Pro and Ultimate plans raise the limits. Current details: https://nirolearn.com/pricing
